description: Source code for a test driver class used in layout tests, including test execution, crash handling, and output parsing.

classes.name: Driver
classes.description: Class for managing test execution, process control, crash detection, and output parsing for layout tests.

classes.name: DriverInput
classes.description: Encapsulates input parameters for a test run, such as test name, timeout, image hash, and arguments.

classes.name: DriverOutput
classes.description: Encapsulates the output of a test run, including text, images, crash info, and errors.

classes.name: ContentBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of content read from the driver process, including headers and binary data.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Runs a single test, manages process lifecycle, and returns a DriverOutput object.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Starts the driver process with specified options and waits for readiness.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the driver process and cleans up temporary resources.

methods.name: cmd_line
methods.description: Constructs the command line arguments for starting the driver process.

methods.name: _read_block
methods.description: Reads a block of output (stdout/stderr) from the driver process until completion or crash.
